contents.role: The pattern, taught end to end for an agent reader: step-zero handle discipline, the baseline as a remembered fact, the check pass, alert and quiet digest formats, scheduling note, accounting.
Agent-facing entry point: what this package makes you able to do and the 5-minute path from reading to a running watch.

Runnable watcher: baseline mode saves the baseline and the rule to memory; check mode recalls the baseline, re-reads the signal, applies the threshold rule, saves the reading, and wraps the digest handover.
No-code standing instructions for a chat agent running the watch on a loop.
Proof: the record of a real watch run on the live endpoint (2026-11-02): baseline, two check passes, the rule's honest no-alert outcome, every receipt and digest link.

description: Agent package: learn the signal watch pattern from the skill inside, then run a recurring watch on Zambo. Save a baseline to memory under your own caller handle, check against it on a schedule, apply a stated threshold rule, save every reading either way, and wrap a digest handover when the rule fires (and a quiet-day digest when it does not).

family.note: Family section: the remaining sibling packages join this list in the interconnection pass, when all five are live.

free_tier: Per agent, keyed to its own caller handle: 20 calls + 1 wrap-up free every day; picking up a handover is always free. Day Pass $0.99 per agent, unlimited 24 hours. Zambo Pass $29 per agent, 30 days. One-time payments, never subscriptions.
name: zambo-watch
positioning: Zambo is the shared work layer the watch's memory and record live on (per-agent memory, verifiable receipts, handovers). It is not a scheduler: the agent's own cron, loop, or operator starts each pass.

proof.rule: Alert when any watched asset moves 3 percent or more from its baseline (BTC, ETH, SOL via live_price).
proof.rule_outcome: No alert: moves were BTC -0.01 percent, ETH +0.02 percent, SOL +0.05 percent on the canonical check pass, minutes after the baseline. The quiet outcome is recorded as-is.
